en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a sculptural relief with multiple draped human figures forming part of a large monument base. The image focuses on the detailed statues, likely allegorical figures, arranged around a pedestal. The front includes printed Italian captions and a photographer credit on the left margin, with a small handwritten signature near the bottom.
